rule: ADR-0051 decision 7: trim and upper-case, then accept only three capitals or the empty string. currencySchema in src/modules/financials/schemas/fields.ts and usp_Financial_Update both implement this one rule, so both read these vectors instead of keeping two hand-written lists that can drift. CK_Financial_CurrencyCode and storedCurrencySchema implement different rules and keep their own vectors.
